t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Each colour of gnome corresponds to a colour of basket in the forest. Some baskets can give more mushrooms that others so start by trying different colour combos to figure out which basket may give more mushrooms. For example, a purple gnome is closer to blue than a grey gnome, and a blue basket may give a certain number of mushrooms. However a red and green gnome, the green is closer to yellow and will give you a basket of that colour. The number of mushrooms varies between basket, but don't forget to try new combos to see if a basket may give a higher number than might be missed early on. Try and remember which colour combos give the best number and time it to the x5 multiplier for the highest score.

vb_textbox.text: Each colour of knome corresponds to a certain colour of basket. Red, pink, purple will give a red basket, yellow, green, and blue will give a yellow basket. Different colours of basket give different numbers of mushrooms. At different stages of the game, each basket will give more mushrooms. When you feel that the same colour is starting to give less mushrooms, try switching colours to see if the other colour gives more mushrooms. Try and guess which colour is the better option at that stage and combine it with the x5 bonus to gain the most points. Try switching between colours regularly to see if the values change and give more points at different stages.
